earnings.title: Motorola Solutions Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: Sales of $3.4 billion, up 12% versus a year ago
Products and Systems Integration sales up 12%

quotes.text: Q3 was another outstanding quarter, with double-digit revenue growth across both segments and all three technologies.
quotes.by: Greg Brown, chairman and CEO, Motorola Solutions

outlook: Fourth quarter 2026 - The company expects revenue growth of approximately 13% compared to the fourth quarter of 2025 and non-GAAP EPS between $5.47 and $5.52 per share.
This assumes approximately 168 million of fully diluted shares and a non-GAAP effective tax rate of approximately 22.5%.

Full-year 2026 - The company now expects revenue of approximately $13.050 billion, up from its prior guidance of $12.975 billion and non-GAAP EPS between $17.94 and $17.99 per share, up from its prior guidance of between $17.62 and $17.72 per share.
This outlook assumes approximately 168 million of fully diluted shares and a non-GAAP effective tax rate between 21.5% and 22%.
